title: Google co-founder Sergey Brin turned his $450 million superyacht into a floating headquarters with an entire deck dedicated to work
summary_full: Google co-founder Sergey Brin's superyacht Dragonfly features a dedicated business deck. This vessel combines luxury with functionality, reflecting his entrepreneurial approach. The yacht includes a private office and helicopter hangar for global business management. Brin's increased involvement in AI development mirrors this work-centric design. Dragonfly reimagines the superyacht as a mobile and productive workspace.
